name: teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams (messaging): me, send, list_inbound, get_thread, reply, mark_read. Every tool maps t

platform_mcp_teams_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_teams_client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration.

platform_mcp_teams_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_teams_client_secret.description: Client secret of the app registration ('Only required for web apps'); leave empty for a public client. Sent in the form body of POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

platform_mcp_teams_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_teams_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent including offline_access and the delegated scopes User.Read Chat.ReadWrite ChatMessage.Send ChannelMessage.Send ChannelMessage.Read.All (work or school accounts only; personal accounts are 'Not supported'). Microsoft may return a new refresh token on every refresh; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/<platform>.json (mode 0600).

platform_mcp_teams_team_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_TEAM_ID
platform_mcp_teams_team_id.description: Team id whose channel threads get_thread and reply use (GET /me/joinedTeams).

platform_mcp_teams_user_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_USER_ID
platform_mcp_teams_user_id.description: Entra object id of the signed-in user (GET /me → id); required by mark_read.

platform_mcp_teams_tenant_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMS_TENANT_ID
platform_mcp_teams_tenant_id.description: Tenant id of the signed-in user; required by mark_read.

tools.name: send
tools.description: `to` is a chat id (19:…@thread.v2 or 19:…@unq.gbl.spaces; GET /me/chats). Delegated ChatMessage.Send; 'Application' permission is migration-only.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: Messages of ONE chat (`channel` = chat id, required), newest first; 'Maximum allowed $top value is 50'. `page` is ignored (nextLink paging); `since` is not sent. text is body.content (HTML for most messages).

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Replies to a channel message: `channel` is the channel id, `thread_id` the root message id, and the team comes from config team_id.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply in a channel thread (`channel` = channel id, `thread_id` = root message id, team from config team_id). 'Only the body property is mandatory'.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Marks the chat `channel` read for the signed-in user (config user_id and tenant_id); 204.
